name: Midousuji Midori
source:
With an overwhelming ability to collect information and skillful literary style, Midosuji has gotten numerous scoops as a journalist, from corrupt politicians to idol scandals. He writes for the magazine "Captain General of Reciting", where his scoops are known as "Captain General Bazookas".

[Translated from [url=https://news.denfaminicogamer.jp/news/260728t]profile[/url]]
